title: 한국·프랑스 NPT 공동회의(5/5) — 3단계 비핵화 로드맵, 트럼프-시진핑 비핵화 재확인과 연결
snippet: May 5 NY UN HQ. 70 government representatives. Kim Sang-jin deputy ambassador presented 3-stage roadmap: freeze → reduction → complete denuclearization. UK, France, Italy, Japan strongly criticized NK nuclear/missile programs. Italy called it 'most brazen violation in NPT history.' Now linked to Trump-Xi denuclearization reaffirmation (5/14-15) — the staged approach gains relevance as US-China signal shared goal. However, NK continues to refuse dialogue.
tag_reason: 5/19에 신규로 보고된 한·프 3단계 로드맵이 트럼프-시진핑 비핵화 재확인(5/14-15)과 연결되는 새로운 맥락 추가. NPT RevCon 폐회일(오늘)에 단계적 비핵화 논의의 실효성 재평가.
